phrases.arabic: السَّاعَة قَدِّيش لازِم أَطْلَع مِن الغُرْفَة؟
phrases.transliteration: s-saa3a qaddish laazim aTla3 min l-ghorfe?

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم، عِنْدِي حِجْز بِاسْم نور
dialogue.english: Hello, I have a reservation under the name Nour.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف الفِندَق
dialogue.english: Welcome, one moment please.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف الفِندَق
dialogue.arabic: إِيْه، لَقِيت الحِجْز، غُرْفَة لِشَخْصَيْن، صَحِيح؟
dialogue.transliteration: eeh, la2eet l-7ijz, ghorfe la-shakhSayn, Sa7ee7?
dialogue.english: Yes, I found it, a room for two, right?

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف الفِندَق
dialogue.english: How many nights will you stay?

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Three nights, God willing.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف الفِندَق
dialogue.arabic: تَمام، هاذَا الْمِفْتاح، الغُرْفَة فِي الدَّوْر الثَّانِي
dialogue.transliteration: tamam, haadha l-muftaa7, l-ghorfe fi d-dawr th-thaani
dialogue.english: Alright, here's the key, your room is on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Is breakfast included?

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف الفِندَق
dialogue.arabic: إِيْه، مِن السَّاعَة سَبْعَة لِعَشَّرَة فِي الفِندَق
dialogue.transliteration: eeh, min s-saa3a sab3a li-3ashra fi l-findaq
dialogue.english: Yes, from seven to ten in the hotel.

dialogue.speaker: نور
dialogue.english: Thanks very much.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف الفِندَق
dialogue.english: Welcome, have a nice stay!

response.arabic: إِيْه، غُرْفَة لِشَخْصَيْن فِي الدَّوْر الثَّالِث
response.transliteration: eeh, ghorfe la-shakhSayn fi d-dawr th-thaalith
response.english: Yes, a room for two on the third floor.

pair.english: How much is the price per night?
Is breakfast included with the room?

pair.arabic: السَّاعَة قَدِّيش لازِم أَطْلَع مِن الغُرْفَة؟
pair.transliteration: s-saa3a qaddish laazim aTla3 min l-ghorfe?
pair.english: What time do I need to check out?

lessons.culture: في اليمن، الفنادق صغيرة وعايلية غالباً، والموظف بيرحّب فيك كضيف وليس زبون. الفطور بيكون بسيط: خبز وجبنة وزيت وعسل.

exercises.prompt: مُوَظَّف الفِندَق بِيْسِألَك: وَعَلَيْكُم السَّلام، تَفَضَّل قُول الاسم؟

too_formal.feedback: فصحى زيادة، باليمني نقول عِنْدِي حِجْز
في اليمن نستخدم أَبْغَى بدل أريد

exercises.prompt: I want a room for two people.
كَيْف تَقول 'How much is the price per night?'
مُوَظَّف الفِندَق بِيْسِألَك: كَم لَيْلَة بِتْقَعُد؟
Is there wifi in the room?

dialogue.speaker: زَبُون
dialogue.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم، أَبْغَى أَحْجِز تَذْكِرَة لِحَلِب
dialogue.english: Hello, I want a ticket to Aleppo.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُم السَّلام، رايِح بَس وِلاّ رايِح جاي؟
dialogue.transliteration: w 3alaykum s-salaam, rayyi7 bas willa rayyi7 jaay?
dialogue.english: One-way only or round trip?

dialogue.speaker: زَبُون
dialogue.english: Round trip, how much?

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: أَرْبَعِمِيَّة رِيال، والْبَاص يِطْلَع السَّاعَة تِسْعَة صُبُح
dialogue.transliteration: arba3imiyya riyal, w l-baaS yiTla3 s-saa3a tis3a SubuH
dialogue.english: Four hundred riyals, the bus leaves at nine in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.english: Yes, if you have your student card.

dialogue.speaker: زَبُون
dialogue.english: I have it, can I pay by credit card?

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: لِلأَسَف كاش بَس، لا نِقْبَل بِطاقات
dialogue.transliteration: lal2asaf kaash bas, la ni2bal biTaa2at
dialogue.english: Unfortunately only cash, we don't accept cards.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.english: About two hours, depending on traffic.

dialogue.speaker: زَبُون
dialogue.english: Okay, thanks.

pair.english: How much is a round-trip ticket?

response.english: Four hundred riyals for the trip.

pair.english: What time does the bus leave?

response.english: It leaves at exactly nine in the morning.

pair.english: Is there a discount for students?

lessons.culture: في اليمن، أشهر وسيلة السفر بين المدن هي الباصات والسيارات المشتركة. معظم الناس يفضلونها لأنها أرخص من الطيران وآمنة جداً. الدفع يكون كاش في المحطات.

exercises.prompt: مُوَظَّف بِيْسِألَك: رايِح بَس وِلاّ رايِح جاي؟
Do you have tickets to Aleppo?
كَيْف تَقول 'How much is a round-trip ticket?'
رَتِّب الْجُمْلَة: بَس / رايِح / تَذْكِرَة / أَبْغَى
رَتِّب الْجُمْلَة: يِطْلَع / قَدِّيش / السَّاعَة / الْبَاص
مُوَظَّف بِيْسِألَك: كَم رِيال عِنْدَك مَعَاك؟

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.english: Hello, where's the check-in counter?

dialogue.speaker: حارِس
dialogue.english: Over there, on the right.

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.english: Here you go, I have my passport and ticket.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.english: How many bags do you have?

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.english: Two bags, and this is my carry-on.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: تَمام، الْوَزْن صَحِيح. وَيْن بَوّابَة الطَّيَّارَة؟
dialogue.transliteration: tamam, l-wazn Sa7ee7. ween bawwaabat T-Tayyaara?
dialogue.english: Fine, the weight is correct. Where's the boarding gate?

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: بَوّابَة رَقِم عَشَّرَة، والطَّيَّارَة تِطْلَع السَّاعَة سِتَّة
dialogue.transliteration: bawwaabat ra2am 3ashra, w T-Tayyaara tiTla3 s-saa3a sitta
dialogue.english: Gate number ten, and the plane leaves at six.

dialogue.speaker: شُرْطِي الحُدُود
dialogue.arabic: الْجَواز لَو سَمَحْت. جايِ سِيّاحَة وِلاّ شُغْل؟
dialogue.transliteration: l-jawaaz law sama7t. jayy siyya7a willa shughul?
dialogue.english: Your passport please. Are you coming for tourism or work?

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.english: Tourism, God willing.

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.english: About two weeks.

response.english: Over there on the left, next to the entrance.

pair.english: How many bags am I allowed to take?
Do you have anything to declare?

response.arabic: لا، مَا عِنْدِي شَيّ الحَمْد لِلّه
response.english: No, I don't have anything, thank God.

pair.english: Are you coming for tourism or work?

lessons.culture: في مطارات اليمن، الموظفون بيتعاملون بأدب وحفاوة. إذا قلت إن شاء الله بعد أي خطة، فهذا يعجبهم ويدل على أخلاقك الحسنة. حياك الله يعني أهلا وسهلا بك.

exercises.prompt: شُرْطِي الحُدُود بِيْسِألَك: جايِ سِيّاحَة وِلاّ شُغْل؟
كَيْف تَقول 'How long will you stay here?'
رَتِّب الْجُمْلَة: تِطْلَع / الطَّيَّارَة / قَدِّيش / السَّاعَة
شُرْطِي الحُدُود بِيْسِألَك: عِنْدَك شَيّ تَصَرَّح عَنّه؟

phrases.arabic: الله يُعَوِّض، إِن شَاءَ الله بِتِنْحِل
phrases.transliteration: allah yu3awwiD, in shaa allah btenHall

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.english: Hello, I lost my bag.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: مَا تخاف، مِن وَيْن كُنْت طالِع؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma tkhaf, min ween kunt Tali3?
dialogue.english: Don't worry, where did you come from?

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.arabic: مِن عَدَن، والطَّيَّارَة كانِت تِأَخَّرِت قَوِي
dialogue.transliteration: min 3aden, w T-Tayyaara kaanat ti2akhkharat qawi
dialogue.english: From Aden, and the plane was very late.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.english: What does the bag look like, what color?

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.transliteration: sawda2 w kabeera, w fiih nu2sha zar2a2
dialogue.english: Black and big, with a blue design.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: تَمام، بِنَسَجِّل بَلاغ. الْجَواز لَو سَمَحْت؟
dialogue.transliteration: tamam, bnsajjel balaagh. l-jawaaz law sama7t?
dialogue.english: Okay, we'll file a report. Your passport please?

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.arabic: مَا لَقِيت الْجَواز بتاعِي دَقِيقَة، إِيْه تفضل
dialogue.transliteration: ma la2eet l-jawaaz bta3i da2ee2a, eeh tfaDDal
dialogue.english: I can't find my passport, wait, here it is.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.english: Thank God. Any other problem?

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.english: Yes, I need to change my flight to tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: أَكِيد، رُوح مَكْتَب الشِّكايِات وهُمّ بيْسااعِدُوك
dialogue.transliteration: akeed, ruuh maktab sh-shikayaat w humm bysaa3duuk
dialogue.english: Of course, go to the complaints office and they'll help you.

dialogue.speaker: مُسافِر
dialogue.arabic: مَا حَدّ رَد عَلَيّ هُناك قَبْل
dialogue.english: Nobody answered me there before.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.english: I'll call them now. Come with me.

pair.english: I missed the bus, what do I do?

response.arabic: فِيه بَاص ثانِي بَعْد سَاعَة، اقْعُد انْتِظِر
response.transliteration: fiih baaS thaani ba3d saa3a, i2'3ud intizir
response.english: There's another bus in an hour, wait.
On the first floor next to security.

pair.english: The bag got broken, who compensates me?

response.english: Go to the airline office here at the airport.

pair.english: I need to change the flight, is it possible?

response.arabic: إِيْه مُمْكِن، بَس فِيه رُسْم تغيير
response.transliteration: eeh mumken, bas fiih rusm taGhyeer
response.english: Yes it's possible, but there's a change fee.

lessons.culture: لما تحصل مشكلة في السفر في اليمن، الناس بيقولون 'الله يعوض' قبل يحكوا عن الحل. هاد احترام وتعاطف أهم من الحل نفسه. والموظفون دايماً بيساعدونك لأن الضيف عند اليمنيين مهم قوي.

exercises.prompt: كَيْف تَقول 'There's a problem with the reservation.'

challenge.title: احْجِز رِحْلَة وحُلّ مُشْكِلَة
challenge.instructions: اعْمِل حِوار قَصِير: احْجِز غُرْفَة بِفِندَق أَوْ تَذْكِرَة سَفَر، وبَعْدِيْن ظَهِرِت مُشْكِلَة (تأْخِير، شِنْطَة ضايِعَة، أَو الطَّيَّارَة فاتِتَك) وَحِكِ كَيْف حَلَّيْتَها.
required_elements: طَلَب حِجْز أَوْ تَذْكِرَة بِجُمْلَة كامِلَة

dialogue.speaker: مُحَمَّد
dialogue.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم، أَبْغَى أَحْجِز تَذْكِرَة لِحَلِب
dialogue.english: Hello, I want to book a ticket to Aleppo.

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُم السَّلام، رايِح بَس وِلاّ رايِح جاي؟
dialogue.transliteration: w 3alaykum s-salaam, rayyi7 bas willa rayyi7 jaay?
dialogue.english: One-way or round trip?

dialogue.speaker: مُحَمَّد
dialogue.english: Round trip, how much?

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.arabic: أَرْبَعِمِيَّة رِيال، الْبَاص يِطْلَع السَّاعَة تِسْعَة
dialogue.transliteration: arba3imiyya riyal, l-baaS yiTla3 s-saa3a tis3a
dialogue.english: Four hundred riyals, the bus leaves at nine.

dialogue.speaker: مُحَمَّد
dialogue.arabic: لِلأَسَف فاتنِي الْبَاص، فِيه بَاص ثانِي؟
dialogue.transliteration: lal2asaf faatni l-baaS, fiih baaS thaani?
dialogue.english: I missed the bus, is there another one?

dialogue.speaker: مُوَظَّف
dialogue.english: Yes, there's a bus in two hours.

dialogue.speaker: مُحَمَّد
dialogue.english: Thank God, thanks a lot.
